fact: FAO honoured the Algerian Space Agency in October 2025 for locating desert locust breeding sites from Alsat satellite images, and the agency built a national platform combining field data and space analysis used by national plant protection services.
title: "الفاو" تكرم الجزائر لمواجهتها الجراد الصحراوي باستخدام التكنولوجيا الفضائية
